reviews.title: A great PSU.
reviews.comment: I am in love with MSI products.  This power supply fit the bill perfectly.  The full modular setup makes cable management a breeze.  It is made with durable components that makes it feel and look like it.  Standard size to fit into an ATX case.  Very quiet and functions perfectly.
reviews.author: Alan P.

reviews.title: silent and great
reviews.comment: got this on sale and it was worth the wait. MSI makes good PSU and this one is marketed as silent which it is under load. price is great and works with my 5070 just fine. i appreciate the 12v cable with yellow connector that will be hidden once seated correctlly (fool proof). cables are also embossed so it feels premium and works well. This checks all the boxes i have (minimal aesthetic, modular, gold efficiency, silent, and supports pcie 5.1)
reviews.author: rip pop smoke

reviews.title: Works but cables are too long
reviews.comment:
Everything works and looks good. My only disappointment is about the length of the cable which is excessively long.
The sata cables have some legacy plugs that are unnecessary and clog further the space in chassis.
If you have a 3.5 HHD attached to the bottom panel of your chassis you won't be able to connect it because there is no sata plug that lays flat (because of the unnecessary bulk caused by legacy plugs attached to the same cable).
Overall a good quality price power supply.
reviews.author: Alberto C.

reviews.title: Quiet and Stable Power Supply
reviews.comment: The power supply is very stable and it fit perfectly in my Cooler Master Centurion 590 case.  The 140mm fan doesn't kick on unless the computer is under heavy load, so it's also very quiet.  The modular cables means that there are no unused cables cluttering up the PC case, and I also like that it includes a 10 year warranty.
reviews.author: Basilius
